name: ReceiptCard
job: Present a short list (menu, order summary, package contents) as a thermal receipt that prints out of a slot
visitor_action: none (prints in view); hover lifts the curled bottom edge
motion: paper feeds down line by line with tiny jitter, edge curls (reduced-motion: printed receipt, flat)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: feed loop stalled when frames were starved; now time-scheduled with timer backup)
checks.craft: 3 (after 1 polish pass: real cork grain, seamless curl tail, printer width on mobile)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Corner cafe: thermal-paper white with faint warm fade, monospaced dark-grey print, torn zig-zag edge, soft drop shadow on a cork-tone ground
notes: Total is summed from item prices (no tax/discount lines); the hover curl is subtle and absent on touch.
